question: What percentage of total net revenue comes from Germany?
verdict_why: every axis an expectation of COMMIT requires passes

flags.reason: 25 acting rules bound to this route (12 choice, 3 implemented_by, 10 prose); none is a claim about the SQL a machine dec
the value axis did not fail, so there is nothing for a semantic check to settle

answer_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.country_name = 'Germany' THEN sl.net_amount END) / SUM(sl.net_amount) * 100,
    2
  ) AS percentage_of_total_net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS sl
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON sl.sale_country_code = c.country_code
